prompts:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: final presentation-ready mechanism infographic for a Chinese systems engineering competition, to insert into a PDF and talk deck.
Create ONE polished wide landscape 16:9 technical illustration, extremely legible Simplified Chinese typography, sharp 4K-style detail, white/off-white background, navy text, restrained teal and blue paths, amber for caution, thin precise vector-like strokes and light flat shading. Academic systems-diagram aesthetic, clean and mature. Plenty of breathing room; no photographic servers, no mascots, no decorative AI brain, no fake UI. Use concise exact text and avoid dense paragraphs.

Title text: "RailFuse ContextStore"
Subtitle: "从多轨传输到完整对象交付"

TECHNICAL CONTENT MUST BE ACCURATE:
This image has TWO CLEARLY SEPARATED sections with no arrows suggesting shared atomicity. Upper section is the Rust multi-rail path. Bottom separate inset is Python/C ABI single-connection lifetime management. The Python C ABI must NOT be shown as having the Rust publication gate or failure-atomic destination guarantee.

Upper main section heading: "Rust 多轨对象读取"
Show a left-to-right data flow:
1. "已有对象条带" on server side, with a small ordered stack labeled "1", "2", "3", "4". These stripes are unchanged on disk.
2. Two independently colored abstract network lanes labeled "Rail 0" and "Rail 1". Rail 0 receives stripes 1,2; Rail 1 receives stripes 3,4. A small control card above these lanes labeled "Placement / 版本" controls "按字节规划 · 资源预算". Do not draw physical NIC performance or two HCAs.
3. A SINGLE request-private ordered staging area labeled "私有有序暂存". Show exactly four adjacent cells 1,2,3,4. Rail 0's data ends ONLY in cells1,2, Rail 1 ONLY in3,4, with non-overlapping slices. There must NOT be any copy from lane-private packed buffers into this vector: this is the direct ordered staging mechanism. A short side label reads "分轨写入互不重叠区域".
4. A clearly visible publication decision gate labeled "发布前检查", with three short chips "完整性", "版本复查", "取消检查".
5. Only a green passing arrow labeled "全部通过后发布" reaches a destination buffer labeled "调用方缓冲区". A small red reject branch terminates below the gate and reads "失败：保留调用方原值". Never draw a failed partial result into the final caller buffer.

Across this main path, give two modest numbered captions positioned meaningfully: "01 怎样分配路径" near planning, "02 何时发布结果" near publication. Arrows must have unambiguous directions and there must be no duplicate staging vectors.

Bottom separate full-width inset, visually detached by whitespace and a dividing rule:
Heading "03 何时回收内存"
Subheading "Python / C ABI：单连接生命周期"
Show four simple connected steps: "传输出错" → "返回前退休 QP" → "排空旧 CQ" → "允许复用 · 显式重连".
Below it clearly state "失败 GET 可含部分数据；不等同于 Rust 多轨原子发布".
Do not connect this inset into the upper final buffer. No invented metrics, no performance percentages, no 100% safety claim, no formal-proof symbols.
Small readable footer: "机制示意｜实验图表与运行记录另附"
The whole image should be harmonious, compact, elegant, richly explanatory through data ownership and arrows, and immediately understandable from left to right. Chinese text must be correctly spelled with clear modern sans-serif type.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: final Chinese competition PDF / talk slide comparison diagram, ONE wide landscape 16:9 image with high-resolution, crystal-clear Simplified Chinese text.
Design a sophisticated but easy-to-understand causal comparison infographic on an off-white background. Navy text, thin precise lines, rounded flat cards, deep teal for fixed safe behavior, muted coral for vulnerable behavior, amber for delayed operations. No stock computer art, no fake screenshots, no 3D noise, no graphs or invented statistics.

Exact title: "请求报错后，DMA 真的结束了吗？"
Subtitle: "同一注册缓冲区的晚到写入与安全复用"
Small scope label below subtitle: "Python 单连接 FFI · 机制示意"

Create two horizontal aligned lanes with identical chronological column positions.
Top lane title: "旧库：错误返回后，QP 仍存活"
Bottom lane title: "修复版：返回前退休 QP"

Five common chronological column headings, in exact left-to-right order:
"① GET 报错返回"
"② 写入复用哨兵"
"③ 转发延迟请求"
"④ 服务端终态"
"⑤ 检查并恢复"

TOP VULNERABLE LANE:
At column1 show a small QP card still active, label "QP 仍可写入".
At column2 show the original registered buffer as FOUR equal adjacent teal cells, all clearly labeled "5A", and caption "同一块注册内存".
Between columns3 and4 show an amber arrow labeled "晚到 RDMA WRITE" reaching this same buffer. The original cells turn coral and now read "PAY" "LOAD" (or one clear payload label spanning all4).
At column4 a terminal response card labeled "GET 响应".
At column5 clearly show "哨兵被 payload 覆盖" and a small explanatory tag "真实污染负对照". The corruption should visibly arise from the late WRITE after reuse, not from memory being freed.

BOTTOM FIXED LANE:
At column1 show the QP retired BEFORE the error returns, with a closed/barrier symbol labeled "QP 已退休".
At column2 show the SAME original registered-buffer representation with FOUR teal "5A" cells.
Between columns3 and4 show an attempted amber "晚到写入尝试" arrow hitting the retired-QP barrier and stopping BEFORE reaching the buffer. Keep the MR and original allocation alive and unchanged.
At column4 show a terminal observation card labeled "响应 / EOF 后".
At column5 show "哨兵完整" with a teal check, then a concise second line "同句柄重连 → PUT/GET 完整".
Do not imply a numeric QPN must change on reconnection. Do not depict a buffer replacement before the late-write observation, and do not depict MR deregistration before the check.

A prominent but tasteful retention bracket under BOTH lanes spans from column1 through column5 and states exactly:
"检查前始终保留原注册内存与 rkey"
A final small annotation AFTER column5 says: "检查完成后，再注销或进入恢复流程".

Readable footer: "基于真实 RXE 负对照与修复验证的机制示意｜不是运行截图"
Keep exact temporal order: error return < sentinel reuse < delayed forwarding < terminal response or EOF < content inspection. No synthetic numerical charts, no blanket zero-risk promise, no claims of physical multi-HCA performance. Make the difference in DMA ownership, buffer content and ordering visually clear, with no visual ambiguity about which memory allocation is retained.
